description:
A sizable extra-axial left cerebellar space-occupying lesion is noted with the following criteria:

epicentered on the left tentorial leaflet with a broad enhancing dural tail attachment

it measures 5.6 x 5.4 x 5.2 cm in maximum dimensions.

expressing T1, T2 and FLAIR isointense signal

it showed avid homogenous post-contrast enhancement.

no evidence of restricted diffusion or SWI blooming

mild peri-focal edema

mass effect in the form of:

buckling of the related cortical gyri

compression of the 4th ventricle with contra-lateral midline shift with subsequent supra-tentorial ventricular dilatation with minimal peri-ventricular CSF permeation

tonsillar herniation with effacement of the medullo-cervical junction
